subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Unit 5: A Letter to a Teacher (Writing)
lesson: Reading a formal letter and discussing its tone and punctuation
outcomes: Find the purpose, structure and tone of a formal letter
Use capital letters, full stops, commas and apostrophes correctly

tf.why: The main body has five paragraphs.

tf.s: The tone of the letter is official but friendly.
We use capital letters for the names of people, places and languages.
tf.why: For example, Ahmed, Muscat and English.

tf.s: The apostrophe in 'She's' shows that 'is' is shortened.
A full stop goes at the beginning of a sentence.
tf.why: A full stop goes at the end of a sentence.

tf.s: 'Shes very late today.' is correctly punctuated.
'english' should be written with a capital E.
tf.why: Languages start with a capital letter.

tf.s: A course co-ordinator is a first-year student.
tf.why: A course co-ordinator organises a course.

boxes.q: Which word needs a capital letter?
boxes.why: Names of places need capitals: Muscat.

boxes.q: Where does a full stop go?
o: at the end of a sentence
at the start of a name
in the middle of a word
boxes.why: A full stop ends a sentence.
The course co-ordinator wrote to new students.

boxes.why: Languages always start with a capital.

boxes.q: How many paragraphs are in the main body?
boxes.why: The main body has five paragraphs.

mcq.q: How does the letter begin and end?
What is the tone of the letter?
mcq.why: The writer is formal but welcoming.

mcq.q: Why do we use capital letters in names?
o: To show names of people, places and languages
mcq.why: Names always start with a capital.

mcq.q: In 'She's late', why is there an apostrophe?

mcq.why: Capitals for the first word and the place, and a full stop.

o: We're going to Nizwa on Friday.
were going to nizwa on friday
We're going to nizwa on Friday
Were going to Nizwa, on friday.
mcq.why: Apostrophe, capitals and a full stop are all correct.

mcq.q: Which sentence is best for a formal letter to a teacher?
o: I am writing to introduce myself.
mcq.why: Formal letters use polite, full sentences.

mcq.q: Why is the tone 'official but friendly'?
o: The writer is formal but wants new students to feel welcome
The writer is a close friend
mcq.why: The co-ordinator is polite and welcoming.

mcq.q: Why are paragraphs useful in a letter?
o: They organise ideas so the reader can follow
mcq.why: Each paragraph has its own idea.

mcq.q: What is wrong with 'Ahmed doesnt speak french.'?
o: It needs an apostrophe and a capital letter
